cover_letter_text:
This is my application for the Civil Design Drafter (Formwork) role advertised on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also modelled a pedestrian Warren truss bridge in Revit. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, tracked procurement and materials, and kept site reports and material records.

Producing panel layouts and take-offs from client and engineering drawings for projects like North East Link is work I want to learn properly, and mentoring from your UK design team would help me do that. My drafting experience is from study rather than three or more years of production work, so I would start at junior level. I am based in Melton VIC with full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the role.

email.subject: Design Drafter application, Marc Masarate
email.body:
Hello Permadec team,

I saw your Civil Design Drafter (Formwork) advert on SEEK and am applying by email as it asks.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards. The course also covered cost estimates and bills of quantities. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings against project requirements and keeping material records. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your formwork on Inland Rail and North East Link is the kind of infrastructure detailing I want to learn, and mentoring from your UK design team is a real draw. To be clear, my drafting experience is from study, not the three or more years of production drafting your advert mentions, so I would come in at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. A few drawing samples from my course are on my portfolio. Would you consider me for this role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
